svg.data-weight-note: 27.9 kg (61.6 lbs) per Table 1 of the guide; "61.6 lbs (27.94 kg)" per the data sheet
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 8.8 x 76.4 cm (19 x 3.50 x 30.1 inches) per Table 1 of the guide, which includes the rack ears. The data sheet gives 43.99 x 8.79 x 76.39 cm "inc. handles".
svg.data-power-draw-note: Table 4 of the guide: "933 W / 1715 W" for the DR3A-54, DR3AM-54 and DR3AK-54. The data sheet measures the typical at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports, excluding transceivers.
svg.data-storage-temp-datasheet: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F), per the data sheet
svg.data-software: EOS; minimum release 4.29.1 per the data sheet
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: datasheet: each QSFP-DD port runs 400G, or 200G, 100G, 50G, 40G (QSFP+) and 25/10G modes by breakout. Maximum values are uni-dimensional and may need breakout cables or transceivers.
svg.data-optics-osfp: datasheet: the two OSFP-LS (line-system) ports are "for dense 400G-ZR deployment", and "Arista's R3A platforms are optimized to support high power 400ZR OSFP and QSFP-DD optical modules".
svg.data-osfp-ls: 2 x OSFP-LS ports for dense 400G-ZR deployment
svg.data-precision-timing: PTP and SyncE with OCXO and PPS/10M/ToD inputs
svg.data-encryption: none on the DR3A-54; all ports (MACsec and TunnelSec) on the DR3AM-54 and DR3AK-54
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial (RS-232), 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control
svg.data-emissions: FCC Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7, EN 55032:2015, VCCI-CISPR 32:2016, AS/NZS CISPR 32:2015
